messages:
ada: quick FYI — telemetry showed a ~3x increase in splitter events for the embed route after yesterday's small preflight toggle. not sure if it's legit spike or miscounting.
liam: saw that too. spikes are in split_count and split_latency p90. payload sizes look normal. could be a perf regression in the router.
maya: are these for mixed-dim payloads only or all embeds? can you paste an example request id?
ada: mostly mixed-dim. sample rid: r=ab12c, tenant=acme-inc. header had: `Content-Length: 1.2MB`, and `X-Embed-Shape: [64,1024]` (we included shape hint in the SDK). ingress-bot: detected splitter: route=embed-v1, action=split, reason=mixed_dims, split_count=3
ken: hmm — split_count metric increments when we emit multiple backend requests. if the SDK shape hint was used maybe the splitter over-split because it misread dimension as tokens. need to confirm parser expectations.
sophia: reminder: we promised the console a new "split heatmap" per-tenant. this spike would look much cleaner if we had a breakdown by dim-pairs. current dashboard only shows bytes and requests.
liam: agree. telemetry ask: add counters: split_count, split_by_reason, split_outcomes (success/fallback/retry), and histogram split_batch_size. also attach route tags: model, tenant, canary_flag.
maya: operationally we should throttle splitter at router-level to avoid cascade. routing policy suggestion: when split_count > 5 for a single request, fastfail with 413-esque payload-too-complex rather than keep retrying.
ada: do we want API-level fastfail or client SDK fastfail? if SDK knows dims it can early-rewrite request and avoid hitting router.
ken: SDK change is safer but adoption takes time. plan: server fastfail for now + SDK opt-in aggressive preflight in next client release.
sophia: console UX: add an alert when split_rate > 0.5% over baseline per tenant, and a link to example traces. product asked for a "why split" explanation in the request inspector (e.g., "mixed dims: [64,512] -> split 2x").
liam: for rollout/telemetry we should tag new metrics with `preflight_v2` so we can A/B. propose canary: 10% traffic with preflight_v2 enabled for 48h, capture split_{count,histogram,reason}, and sample 1% of full traces.
maya: +1. add additional gauge: preflight_decision_time_ms so we can see overhead. also add per-tenant quota hits for splits to console to aid SRE.
sophia: how do we show cost impact? ask runtime to emit estimated token-units for each sub-request; we can surface aggregated added_unit_cost in the console.
ada: runtime already calculates estimated_units. let's include `x-est-units` in the splitter event so console can sum it.
ken: small API detail: prefer header `X-Embed-Estimated-Units` rather than ad-hoc field in logs for consistent tracing across services.
liam: question for eng-runtime: does the splitter preserve KV cache keys when emitting sub-requests? we don't want cache misses to inflate cost.
ingress-bot: note: preflight_v2 can be enabled per-tenant via console flag. rollout helper: `curl -XPOST https://console/api/flags -d '{"tenant":"acme-inc","flag":"preflight_v2","pct":10}'`
sophia: UX note: when a tenant toggles preflight, show an explanatory modal: "preflight runs a light shape analysis; may surface additional split events and estimated cost". include link to docs.
maya: action items:
- liam: add split metrics (split_count, split_reason, split_latency_hist, split_est_units) w/ tag preflight_v2
- ken: server fastfail when split_count > 5 + 413 message text
- ada: gather example traces and list top 10 tenants affected
- sophia: console heatmap + alert rule draft
- liam + maya: canary pipeline config for 10%/48h
ada: timeline: can we ship metrics + server fastfail in 48h? then console in 1 week? who's owning the docs update?
liam: metrics + fastfail: 48h ok. console mockups: sophia to own, docs: i'll draft a short RFC for SDK/HTTP header guidance.
sophia: I'll mock heatmap by EOD and share in #product for feedback.
ken: on the parser fix — I'll add defensive checks so SDK hints can't be mis-parsed (e.g., allow commas, whitespace, bracket variants) and add unit tests.
maya: capture: roll forward with canary next Tue. tagging and sampling set. I'll create the runbook for split-induced throttles.
ada: thanks team. small follow-up: do we want to expose `X-Embed-Units` to customers in the hosted API or only use for internal cost breakdown?
sophia: product wants it in the console and optional header for customers who want to precompute cost. default : internal-only.
liam: final: open PRs referencing issue #1287 and add telemetry dashboards in Grafana/console draft. :thumbsup:
notes: No title field as per agents.md. Thread is a single continuous string of messages prefixed by sender names.
